saw_lines: Triathletes buy a race pass once a season, then renew it when their race calendar and club membership require it.
So the sale is won or lost at the moment they check whether they qualify, before they reach any checkout.
Your 27 Google ads are all text, first shown in 2021 and last in March 2026, so test race entry and club membership angles, each with an image or video version.
